items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: So Edmund Hall Hogg was playing with the Pensacola Jazz Band, and they came to Mobile, and I sat in with them and played.

ctx.x: So Edmund Hall Hogg was playing with the Pensacola Jazz Band, and they came to Mobile, and I sat in with them and played. And that's how I got started out.
Well, tell me something about that band. First of all, how old was Edmund Hall Hogg when he was playing in that band? A little older than you?
